subject: RE: One room for 2 nights next month
body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for getting in touch. This desk is built for group, multi-room and VIP bookings, so for a single Classic Room the fastest route is our regular booking page, where you can see live rates and book directly: https://example.com/book.

If your plans grow into a small group at any point, come straight back to me.

Warm regards,
Hotel Aurora Sales & Events
